in_sanskrit.name: Dhollika
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is fond of dolls or toys.

in_hindi.name: दोल्ली
in_hindi.long_meaning: दोला (Dolla) - a small doll, toy; गुड़ी (Guddi) - a small girl; टोय (Toi) - toy, plaything. Dolly can be derived from any of these three Hindi words.

in_tamil.name: தோலி
in_tamil.long_meaning: ஆல் (Aal) - a wooden stick used as a toy; ஆலவு (Aalavu) - a small wooden stick used as a toy; வெளியிடும் குழந்தை (Veliyidum Kuzhndai) - a child who plays outside. Dolly can be derived from any of these three Tamil words.

in_telugu.name: దొల్లీ
in_telugu.long_meaning: దొల (Dol) - a toy, doll; దొల్లు (Dollu) - a toy; బొయ్యజేయోదు (Boyyajeyudu) - a boy who plays with toys. Dolly can be derived from any of these three Telugu words.

in_marathi.name: Dolly
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dolly हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। There is no widely accepted meaning for the name Dolly in Hindu or Sanskrit mythology or culture.

in_bengali.name: Dolly
in_bengali.long_meaning: Dolly একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। There is no widely accepted meaning for the name Dolly in Hindu or Sanskrit mythology or culture.
